hint_ladder: Say that someone started talking about a subject.
Use bring plus up; a pronoun object goes between them: bring it up.
Start with the words: She brought ___ an interesting point at the meeting.
teaching_content.reveal_form: She brought up an interesting point at the meeting.
canonical_forms: She brought up an interesting point at the meeting.
alternative_realizations: I don't want to bring up the money question again.
